title: 1990 AMC 8 Problem 14
statement: A bag contains only blue balls and green balls. There are \(6\) blue balls. If the probability of drawing a blue ball at random from this bag is \(\dfrac14,\) then the number of green balls in the bag is

solutions.text:
Since blue balls make up \(\dfrac14\) of the bag and there are \(6\) of them, the total is \(6 \cdot 4 = 24\) balls.

So the number of green balls is \(24 - 6 = 18\).

Thus, the correct answer is B .
hints: If the probability of blue is \(\dfrac14,\) then blue balls are a quarter of the total
Use \(6\) blue balls to find the total, then subtract to get the green balls
